designationHistory.indexText: The Eberstadt family donated the 80-acre former estate of New York banker Ferdinand Eberstadt at Lloyd Harbor to the Interior Department in 1967 under the Migratory Bird Conservation Act, creating Target Rock National Wildlife Refuge.

authority.citation: Donation accepted under the Migratory Bird Conservation Act

designationHistory.note: Pass A (fws.gov: the Eberstadts donated 80 acres in 1967 through the Migratory Bird Conservation Act) and Pass B (Town of Huntington trail guide: the Eberstadt estate was donated to the Interior Department in 1967) agree on the year and donor. No exact date was found.
